Lohagad Fort Closed Amidst Murder Probe and Surge in 'Dark Tourism'

Lohagad Fort has been temporarily closed to visitors as police investigate the murder of Ketan Agarwal. The closure follows a significant increase in tourist footfall, with many visitors reportedly drawn to a specific spot, informally named 'Siya Point', linked to the crime. Police are conducting forensic analysis and crime scene reconstructions as part of their investigation into the incident.
